title: Internal policy comparison across adversarial multi-fidelity scenarios

candidate_pool.pairing_rule: Within each scenario, dimension, severity and seed, every policy receives the same candidate-ID set and high-fidelity truth. Across seed values, the candidate pool changes deterministically.
candidate_pool.ground_truth: High-fidelity analytic truth from the scenario registry; audit queries are performed after each policy returns.
candidate_pool.reason_for_minimum: Largest frozen low-fidelity sampling count among current internal policies.

objective_and_scoring.primary_metric: observed high-fidelity feasible archive hypervolume divided by the finite-pool high-fidelity feasible archive hypervolume
objective_and_scoring.caveat: Finite-pool normalized hypervolume is a controlled synthetic diagnostic, not a COCO-native score and not physical casting quality.
objective_and_scoring.independent_scoring_status: Post-policy analytic truth audit is performed by this runner; this result JSON is not yet re-scored by the separate immutable-trace scorer. This remains a diagnostic comparison, not publication-grade evidence.

policies.role: paired discrepancy correction with high-fidelity anchors
budget-responsive transparent heuristic with correction and promotion

diagnostics: Fidelity evaluation counts and actual cost units
Paired-seed mean/median hypervolume delta versus high_only

acceptance_gates.cost_accounting: Every policy run must satisfy sum(fidelity_cost_units_by_level) == cost_spent <= cost_budget.
acceptance_gates.pairing: All policy comparisons are paired by identical scenario, dimension, severity, seed and candidate pool.
acceptance_gates.failure_accounting: Invalid and failed high-fidelity evaluations, when supported by future adapters, must still consume budget and be retained in the result record.
acceptance_gates.inferential_claims: The three-seed default is diagnostic only. Use at least 20 paired seeds (target 30), predeclared multiple-comparison handling and per-cell/task effects before inferential superiority claims.
acceptance_gates.external_sota: No SOTA claim until pinned BoTorch MF-HVKG/MOMF and suitable single-fidelity baselines have been executed under matched budgets and the external lock protocol is satisfied.
acceptance_gates.physical_validation: No foundry claim until a frozen casting simulator and held-out physical validation data exist.
acceptance_gates.independent_trace_score: Before publication, export an immutable trace/receipt pair and verify metrics with a separate scorer and digest lock; the in-process audit here is not an independent scoring path.

limitations: The suite runs repository-internal policies only; it does not run external BoTorch, COCO, NSGA-II or physical casting models.
The scenario equations are synthetic challenge cases and may not represent every real foundry discrepancy.
Default paired-seed percentile-bootstrap intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
The source policy API is a capability-limited interface, not a sandbox against same-process Python introspection.
Finite candidate-pool hypervolume cannot substitute for continuous-domain or COCO-native assessment.
Wall-clock, memory and optimizer overhead are not measured by this runner and must be reported in a later controlled environment.
